newsitem.title: UK: Austin Reed's like-for-like sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Austin Reed's like-for-like sales rise.

text.p: British retailer Austin Reed Group Plc said on Thursday its like-for-like sales rose about 8.0 percent in the first 10 weeks of its financial year versus last year's period.
"Manufacturing order books are healthy," the firm said in a statement reporting its annual results.
Austin Reed said it planned to increase its distribution of mens and womenswear in the UK and expand its network of licensing partners abroad.
"Our key brands, Austin Reed, Chester Barrie and Stephens Brothers have clearly defined market positions, and we have the strategies in place to deliver sustainable growth," the firm said.
Austin Reed doubled its pretax profit to 6.8 million stg for the year ended January 31.
The firm's shares were marked up 3.5p to 255 by 0720 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
